note: The one package the app's Load Latest Approved Package button will fetch. Every sha256 below is of the COMMITTED bytes (LF line endings) — the same bytes GitHub Pages serves. A working copy checked out on Windows with core.autocrlf=true will hash differently, which is why the button refuses a local copy rather than trusting it. file must be a bare filename: the app resolves it inside its own packages/ folder and refuses anything that resolves elsewhere.

latest.title: Category 08 show sync v3
latest.summary: The Last Fling updated in place, Mistletoe & Martinis added, Party on the Pavement reinstated as Passed / Not Doing, the 2026 Rustic Fox holiday series passed, and its replacement North Aurora market added. Wonderful World of Weddings deliberately untouched.

history.why: Its Party on the Pavement operation was a markPassed, which only matches an existing record. The record is absent from the board while its migration marker still suppresses re-seeding, so the operation returned UNMATCHED and the decision left no trace.

Its Last Fling operation matched on exact name + date against 'The Last Fling' while the board holds 'The Last Fling Artisan Market', so it would have created a duplicate on the same day at the same venue.
